item.title: [Recap] Nikola Jokić (DEN): Nikola Jokić accumulated 28 points (12-of-21 FGs, 2-of-2 FTs), 15 rebounds, seven assists, one steal, one block and two three-pointers in Monday’s loss to the Suns.
item.description:
Nikola Jokić accumulated 28 points (12-of-21 FGs, 2-of-2 FTs), 15 rebounds, seven assists, one steal, one block and two three-pointers in Monday’s loss to the Suns.

The good news for fantasy managers was that Jokić recorded a full stat line on Monday, finishing with his 10th double-double of the season. However, he also committed seven turnovers, matching his season high in that category. By Jokić’s standards, he started slowly, but the Nuggets’ center has remained one of the best players in fantasy basketball, regardless of league format.

Raphielle Johnson
